## Librerías
```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(seqinr)
library(adegenet)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(DECIPHER)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

## 1. Cargar secuencias de virus
```{r}
virus <- c(
  # Genomas humanos
  "MZ472095.1", "MZ472096.1", "MZ472097.1", "MZ472098.1", "MZ472099.1",
  "MZ363983.1", "OL790194.1", "OR938501.1", "PP046504.1", "PP046509.1",
  "MT079851.1", "MT079845.1", "MT121215.1", "MZ318028.1", "MT123292.2",
  "PX063729.1", "MZ544366.1", "MT350282.1", "OQ050422.1", "MW466799.1",
  "MW397523.1", # Perro
  "PX759543.1", # Ave
  "MT186683.1", # Murciélago
  "PQ594656.1", # Animal de granja (Vison)
  "OK235487.1" # Animal acuático (Nutria de río)
)
```

## Descargar secuencias de GenBank
```{r}
seq <- read.GenBank(virus, species.names = TRUE, as.character = FALSE)
ape::write.FASTA(
  seq,
  file = "virus_seq.fasta"
)
virus_seq <- readDNAStringSet("virus_seq.fasta")
```

## 2. Calcular la longitud de cada secuencia
```{r}
seq_lengths <- BiocGenerics::width(virus_seq)

seq_lengths_named <- data.frame(
  Secuencia = names(virus_seq),
  Longitud = seq_lengths
)

seq_lengths_named
```

## 3. Composición de nucléotidos
```{r}
nucleotide_composition <- function(dna) {
  bases <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")
  chars <- strsplit(as.character(dna), "")[[1]]
  counts <- sapply(bases, function(base) sum(chars == base))
  percentages <- round((counts / length(chars)) * 100, 2)
  list(counts = counts, percentages = percentages)
}

compositions <- lapply(virus_seq, nucleotide_composition)

composition_table <- data.frame(
  Virus = names(virus_seq),
  A = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["A"]),
  C = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["C"]),
  G = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["G"]),
  T = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["T"])
)

composition_data <- reshape2::melt(composition_table, id.vars = "Virus")

ggplot(composition_data, aes(x = Virus, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Comparación de Composición de Nucleótidos entre Variantes de SARS-CoV-2",
    x = "Virus",
    y = "Porcentaje (%)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = "blue", "C" = "green", "G" = "red", "T" = "yellow"))
```

## 4. Contenido de GC
```{r}
gc_content <- function(dna) {
  comp <- nucleotide_composition(dna)$percentages
  round(comp["G"] + comp["C"], 2)
}

gc_values <- sapply(virus_seq, gc_content)

gc_data <- data.frame(
  Virus = names(virus_seq),
  GC_Content = gc_values
)

gc_table <- data.frame(
  Virus = names(virus_seq),
  `Porcentaje de GC` = gc_values
)

kable(
  gc_table,
  caption = "Porcentaje de GC en cada secuencia de virus SARS-CoV-2"
)
```

## 5. Secuencias contrasentido
```{r}
seq_reverse <- reverseComplement(virus_seq)
seq_reverse
```
